secrets.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Google API key for the Custom Search JSON API; enables LIVE web research together with GOOGLE_CSE_ID and OPENAI_API_KEY. Without the provider keys the app runs in its intentional DEMO mode.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CSE_ID
secrets.description: Optional. Programmable Search Engine ID (cx) used with GOOGLE_API_KEY for LIVE web research.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. OpenAI API key for the LIVE LangChain research adapter. Demo mode works without it.
